name: agent
description: Canonical Agent Skills, portable Agent Plugins packages, and optional host compatibility maintained by dev-hobin.

scripts.check:portable: pnpm check:standard && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @hobin/developer check:portable && pnpm --filter @hobin/learning check:portable
